findings.title: Always perform independent post-component global closure before any return/exception/result-reference verdict can escape
findings.source_fact: Only the final qualified-result path reaches closed_backends OWNER_READ_POST_COMPONENT. Coordinator throws, partial result, malformed identity/fields/results and summary write/save failure escape earlier. The child finally is not independent outer closure proof.
findings.bounded_required_fix: Use nested finally covering the invocation and bounded fixed child report reference retention. Always attempt global closure for all databases/roles/tags on return or throw, including stat/read/save failures. Retain typed confirmed/unconfirmed flags before verdicts. If closure is unconfirmed, stop before result qualification and final native observations; preserve only bounded hash/path/count partial evidence and original failure classification. Add failed/throwing/different-tag client/observer error/reference I/O regressions.

findings.title: Evidence persistence errors must not skip independent cleanup attempts
findings.source_fact: Bare save() in FINALLY_FINALIZATION or SANITIZATION exception handlers can raise out of the main finally before cleanup(). The same frozen-main pattern exists in Lease Snapshot V3 and Restore Closure V3.
findings.bounded_required_fix: Nonthrowing best-effort recording/persistence around each finalizer, scan, cleanup and preservation step. Every target/owned resource and host-secret cleanup must still be independently attempted when any evidence write fails. Preserve STOP, mark evidence/cleanup unconfirmed, fail return on evidence incompleteness. No retries/SQL/permission/timeouts relaxation. Root will sequence new versioned Lease/Restore source corrections separately.
